items.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024
items.q: I would love to have heard Louis Armstrong and the Hot 5 session.

ctx.x: Do you have a place that you wish you could have been, to get in a time machine and experience a particular recording, a particular event?

Yeah, I mean I guess we all have that. I don’t know if I could pinpoint one in particular but obviously Charlie Parker either you know the “Koko” session maybe or you know maybe a specific event but something. You know that was a name that I grew up with in Kansas City that helped me get into things because there was somebody that I knew was important, just like Count Basie, even when I didn’t know where they fit within things I knew they were important. So Charlie Parker, not for that reason but just for musical…

the West Coast things are concerned I would have loved to have been able to hear that group with Gerry and Chet at The Haig for example. I’m sure I could think of dozens more but you know off the top of my head those type things, you know, hearing Dizzy and Bird together in their prime I think would have been for me — now of course I’d love to have heard Bix Beiderbecke, I would love to have heard Louis Armstrong and the Hot 5 session. I would love to have been able to actually witness some of those landmark big…
